title: vandhE mAdhavam - varALi - Geetham - chatushra matya  - Paidala Gurumurthy Sastry
name: vandhE mAdhavam

lyrics: maNi rAja kundalam - madhu dhaithya kandanam
nava nAga kundalam - Arya guNa mandalam

text: O sweetest one, who respects Goddess Parvati's husband. Krishna! I praise you. You have eyes as bright as the lotus. You are simply modest in appearance, the one who grants boons to the entire world. You are so auspicious among all kings, and you destroyed demons like madhu. You made Goddess Lakshmi happy by letting her reside in your heart. You wore everlasting ornaments in the shape of a serpent. You pursued the greatest degree of virtue. You rest on the Serpent. Release me from attachments and emotions and give me salvation.

lyric: maNi rAja kunDalaM madhu daitya khanDanaM
text: O sweetest one (mAdhava), who respects (mAnIta) Goddess Parvati's (uma) husband (dhavam). Krishna (mAdhavaM), I praise you (vandE). You have eyes as bright (lOchanaM) as the lotus (pankaja). Release (mOchanaM) me from attachments (bandha) and emotions (bhava). You appear as if you wore clouds (neerabha) as clothes (vasnaM), and you are the one who can bless the entire world (nikhila) with the one (eka) of many boons (daayinaM), i.e., moksha. You are so auspicious (like maNi) among all rAjas (rAja kunDalaM). You destroyed (khanDanaM) demons (daitya) like madhu. You made Goddess Lakshmi (indira) happy (ullAsa) by letting her reside in your heart (vaksha). You wore everlasting (nava) ornaments (kunDalam) in the shape of a serpent (nAga). You pursued (manDalam) the greatest degree (Arya) of virtue (guNa). You rest on the Serpent, and you give (dAyinaM) salvation (mOksha) to your devotees (ASrita).
